description:
Get the actual screenshot so you can see the UI. For marketing pages taller than 4000px,
preview returns only the first screen (above the fold); use size=full for the whole page,
which can exceed what vision models accept. getScreen lists the page's sections with their
y offsets so you know what's below the fold.

screenId.description: Screen id from searchScreens or getProduct, e.g. linear-signup.

size.description: preview (default) keeps images small enough to view; full returns the original capture.

name: get_screen_image
title: Get a screen's screenshot
